blocks.text: Bohat se enzymes catalysis mein madad ke liye izafi kemiyai (chemical) ajza istemal karte hain. Yeh izafi ghair-protein ajza cofactors hain. Cofactor ki teen qismein hain: metal ions, prosthetic groups aur coenzymes.

blocks.title: Apoenzyme aur holoenzyme
blocks.text: Enzyme ka protein hissa apoenzyme hai, aur cofactor samet mukammal enzyme holoenzyme hai.

Bohat se enzymes Ca2+, Mg2+, Mn2+, Cu2+ aur Zn2+ jaise metal ions ko apne cofactors ke taur par istemal karte hain. Yeh metal ions enzymes ke ghair-faal (non-functional) active sites ko faal (functional) banate hain. Cofactor ka jurna enzyme ki shakal bhi badalta hai aur use substrate se milne deta hai.

blocks.alt: Teer (arrows) se jure paanch enzyme khaakon ka chakkar (cycle). V jaisi shakal ke active site wala enzyme aur us ke upar substrate; ek cofactor neeche se enzyme ki taraf aata hai; cofactor andar aane par active site aisi shakal le leta hai jo substrate ki dandi (stem) mein fit ho; substrate us mein beth kar enzyme-substrate complex banata hai; do products enzyme se alag hote hain aur cofactor enzyme mein reh jata hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chakkar ko baen (left) neeche se shuru karein. Pehle enzyme ka active site V jaisa hai, substrate ki chokor dandi us mein fit nahin hoti, yani site ghair-faal (non-functional) hai. Peela cofactor (maslan Mg2+ jaisa metal ion) enzyme se jurta hai aur active site ki shakal badal deta hai. Ab substrate fit ho kar enzyme-substrate complex banata hai, aur aakhir mein products alag ho jate hain. Cofactor enzyme ke saath rehta hai.

blocks.title: Trace elements
blocks.text: Molybdenum aur manganese jaise bohat se trace elements, jo hamari sehat ke liye zaroori hain, enzymes cofactors ke taur par istemal karte hain.
Kuch cofactors enzyme ke saath covalent bonds banate hain aur prosthetic groups kehlate hain. Prosthetic group ek organic compound ho sakta hai, maslan haematin.

Jab cofactor ek ghair-protein organic molecule ho jo enzyme se dheela jura ho to yeh coenzyme hai. Coenzymes enzyme ke catalyse kiye reactions mein hissa lete hain, aksar electrons (hydrogen atoms) ko ek enzyme se doosre tak le ja kar. Bohat se vitamins, maslan niacin aur riboflavin, coenzymes ka kaam karte hain, aur kuch coenzymes ka hissa hain.

Cell ka sab se aham coenzyme hydrogen lene wala (acceptor) nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) hai. Jab NAD+ kisi enzyme se hydrogen atom leta hai to yeh reduce ho kar NADH banta hai. Hydrogen atom ke electron mein tawanai (energy) hoti hai jo NADH molecule le jata hai. Maslan jab cell mein khuraak oxidise hoti hai to enzymes khuraak ke molecules se electrons kheench kar NAD+ ko dete hain, jo reduce ho kar NADH banta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek enzyme ko apna substrate badalne ke liye zinc chahiye, aur NAD+ doosre se hydrogen le jata hai. Har soorat mein cofactor ki qisam batayen, aur prosthetic group aur coenzyme ka farq samjhayen.
blocks.explanation: Zinc metal ion cofactor hai; NAD+ coenzyme hai. Prosthetic group enzyme se covalent bonds se jura hota hai, jabke coenzyme ghair-protein organic molecule hai jo sirf dheela jura hota hai aur electrons ya hydrogen ek enzyme se doosre tak le ja sakta hai.

items: Cofactors ghair-protein madadgar hain: apoenzyme (protein) aur cofactor mil kar holoenzyme.

Metal ions (Ca2+, Mg2+, Mn2+, Cu2+, Zn2+) active site ko faal banate hain; prosthetic groups (haematin) covalent jure hain; coenzymes (NAD+, niacin aur riboflavin jaise vitamins) dheele jure hain aur electrons ya hydrogen le jate hain.
NAD+ hydrogen atom le kar NADH banta hai, jo us electron ki tawanai le jata hai, jaise jab khuraak oxidise hoti hai.
